Studio Visit Fee Breakpoints

Enter two studio plans' fixed fees, included visits and progressive or block pricing, then press “Compare visit counts” to see the amount for every count from 0 to the maximum, and the continuous ranges where the cheaper plan changes.

Comparison range

0–240 visits. The result lists every count from 0 up to this number.

Plan A

1–24 characters, first character a letter or digit; the two names must differ.

Pricing mode

0–1,000,000. Charged even at 0 visits.

0–240 visits. Visits within this count are not charged extra.

Per-visit band prices

1–5 bands. Each band takes a cumulative extra-visit upper bound and a per-visit price; only the last band has no bound (unlimited). Bounds must strictly increase.

1–240 visits. A partial block still counts as one block.

Plan B

1–24 characters, first character a letter or digit; the two names must differ.

Pricing mode

0–1,000,000. Charged even at 0 visits.

0–240 visits. Visits within this count are not charged extra.

Per-visit band prices

1–5 bands. Each band takes a cumulative extra-visit upper bound and a per-visit price; only the last band has no bound (unlimited). Bounds must strictly increase.

1–240 visits. A partial block still counts as one block.

The sample is fixed placeholder data (a block of 2 visits for 600 against 350 per visit, compared up to 4 visits); press “Compare visit counts” to compute it.
